sections.title: Raw source
items: Summary: Temporary conditions or effects can be cleared through the listed move, feature text, natural end, or spell/Fear procedure.
When: Use when a feature says an effect or condition is temporary.
Not When: Do not create a new global condition just because an effect is temporary.
Answer: Use the effect text first. If it is a temporary condition, clear it through the appropriate move or spotlight procedure.
Example: A temporary thorn restraint asks what action frees the trapped PC.
